verdict.left_looks: A dark, nearly black box sits on a grey stone-brick plinth, with a wide overhanging band of oak planks and black cap above it. The front has a few small glass windows, a wooden double door, an orange awning block, a glowstone sign, lanterns, leaf-block planters and small tables as an outdoor terrace. The side and back are large blank black walls. The overhanging roof band reads as a heavy lid.
verdict.right_looks: A one-storey box with a checkered black-and-light base, black pillars, and a grey and beige cornice band on top. Large multi-pane glass walls fill the bays between the pillars on all sides, and a wooden door is in the front center. Through the glass you can see an interior with a checkered floor, hay or wool bale seating, wooden counters and potted plants. The form is very regular and flat-roofed.
verdict.why: The right build has a rhythmic pillar-and-glass facade, a visible furnished interior and an even look on all four sides, while the left has a heavy lid-like roof band and large blank black walls on the sides and back, even though its front terrace props are charming.
